candidats.titre: File:Louis Voisinet House, Tonawanda, New York - 20191003.jpg
candidats.description: The Louis Voisinet House, 429 Englewood Ave. at Fairfield Ave., Tonawanda, New York. One of the oldest buildings in the town, it was built in 1828 by its then forty-year-old namesake, a native of Évette-Salbert, France who had immigrated the same year with his wife and children. His eldest son, also named Louis, inherited the house and the 102 acres (41 ha) of farmland on which it sat, later expanding the family's land holdings to 130 acres (52 ha) and becoming one of the most distinguished citizens of Tonawanda of his day.
